scene: You step from the mail train into the echoing lost property depot.
picture: Flat side view. Along one platform, the red mail train stands open on the left. The player, a middle-aged Black man with grey beard, prosthetic leg, orange corduroy jacket, beanie, and brass telescope, stands left of centre. Far left sits a locked yellow chest. Centre is a wheeled sorting robot. Right stands an umbrella rack.
shown: a locked bright yellow chest on the platform floor on the far left
a clunky wheeled sorting robot holding a feather duster in the centre
a tall metal rack brimming with colourful hooked umbrellas on the right

variants.scene: The cavernous depot echoes with the quiet clatter of busy machinery.
You arrive under dim arched lights, still searching for {quest}.
Piles of forgotten luggage surround a bustling Lost and Found booth.
